The main takeaway from our work is that
the NGD algorithm is a robust first-order optimization algorithm for a wider class functions than the vanilla SGD algorithm.
the normalized gradient descent algorithm, when used in conjunction with stochastic optimization, can be used to minimize quasi-convex functions that are not necessarily convex.
